Question 1
WHO closes the program??
A. Sponsor
B. Governance board
C. PMO
D. Customer
The answer is incorrect

The correct answer is: Governance board

Question 2
Which is not a phase of the program life cycle?
A. Initiation
B. Closure
C. Setup &amp; tuning
D. Planning
E. Delivery

F. Preparation
Your answer is correct.

The correct answer is: Setup & tuning
